operator_authorization: 11.10.2026: 'daglig GC-volum og open interest er gratis fra CME ja! Dette kjører vi.' Scope admitted by this manifest: identify and document free, unrevised daily COMEX GC futures volume/open-interest sources and the CFTC COT open-interest archive, with their publication clocks and licence terms. No account, key, agreement acceptance, payment, bulk data download, model fit, period change, native change or TEST access.
evidence_scope: Public documentation and directory-listing inventory only. Not source admission, not predictor admission, not profitability evidence. A separate manifest-bound fetch with an exact URL, byte limit, schema and availability clock is required before any series enters the research panel.
why_this_source: Daily futures volume, open interest and delta-open-interest are activity/positioning inputs for the D1/weekly macro-B arm (positioning x price change). They are published once per day and not revised after the final report, so the provenance requirement is a documented publication lag, not an ALFRED-style vintage chain (rule 1: declared publication lag respected).
method: For each named candidate URL: one unauthenticated HTTPS HEAD, then at most one GET limited to maximum_bytes, timeout 30 s, no auto-redirect (a redirect is recorded and not followed), no retries, no alternate endpoints, no query parameters beyond those listed. Record status, headers, content-type, byte count, SHA-256 of the received prefix and the first 4 KiB as text evidence. Never parse a response as market data in this probe.

candidates.expected_content: Landing page for the Daily Bulletin (per-day PDF sections incl. metals futures volume/open interest) and any archive link.
questions: Is the format PDF-only or also CSV/XLS?

candidates.expected_content: HTTP mirror listing of the FTP bulletin archive, if public.
Volume & Open Interest report landing page; documents report timing (preliminary/final) and any downloadable history.
questions: Depth of history in the web tool?

candidates.expected_content: Yearly compressed COT archives (futures-only and combined) including total open interest per market, Tuesday as-of dates.
questions: Exact file names for futures-only yearly archives?
Does the archive contain the as-published values (unrevised)?

candidates.expected_content: Release schedule (Friday 15:30 ET for Tuesday positions) and revision policy; needed to bind the publication lag.

required_before_separate_fetch_manifest: Exact machine-readable URL pattern per date or per year with measured earliest date
Documented publication clock (preliminary vs final) to bind availability lag per field
Licence/terms statement permitting offline research use
Per-file byte limit, schema (columns/units), contract identity (front month vs aggregate) and SHA-256 receipts
not_admitted_by_this_probe: Any fit, backtest or native change
Any paid vendor, account or SDK
